answers.what: Deeper is a free add-on for AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini.
answers.does: It rewrites a simple request into a more thorough, expert-style prompt, adding useful steps, tools, starting information, and ways to check the result. It shows you the rewritten prompt and waits for your approval before anything runs.
answers.who: It is for people who want fuller, more practical answers from an AI assistant without knowing how to write expert prompts themselves.
answers.next: Go to deeper.tools/start, copy the provided text, and paste it into a ChatGPT chat. Then type “/deeper” before your request and review the rewritten prompt before approving it.
